scope: One integrated BF native producer for already admitted normalized source; not whole Stage A
input: dot_offset_u64le | repeated u8 chunk length and exact bytes | 00 a5
output: 00 on rejection, or 01 | elf_size_u32le | exact ELF | a5
invalid_transport: extra trailing bytes vetoed by host
capacity: u16 native-byte overflow rejects before native output; multi-chunk source must not truncate at 255
mandatory_external_facts: actual input count and successful read/close
exact complete output and successful write/close
independent native validation before debug packaging
